arxiv-2006-00471.title: Continuous-variable assisted thermal quantum simulation
arxiv-2006-00471.creator: Dan-Bo Zhang, Guo-Qing Zhang, Zheng-Yuan Xue, Shi-Liang Zhu, Z. D. Wang
arxiv-2006-00471.description: Abstract Simulation of a quantum many-body system at finite temperatures is crucially important but quite challenging. Here we present an experimentally feasible quantum algorithm assisted with continuous-variable for simulating quantum systems at finite temperatures. Our algorithm has a time complexity scaling polynomially with the inverse temperature and the desired accuracy.

arxiv-2011-11749.title: Validity and Reliability of the Scale Internet Users’ Information Privacy Concern (IUIPC) [Extended Version] Thanks: Open Science Framework: https://osf.io/5pywm . This is the author’s version of this work.
arxiv-2011-11749.creator: Thomas Groß
arxiv-2011-11749.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Thomas Groß. Internet Users’ Information Privacy Concerns (IUIPC-10) is one of the most endorsed privacy concern scales. It is widely used in the evaluation of human factors of PETs and the investigation of the privacy paradox. Even though its predecessor Concern For Information Privacy (CFIP) has been evaluated independently and the instrument itself seen some scrutiny, we are still missing a dedicated confirmation of IUIPC-10, itself. We aim at closing this gap by systematically analyzing IUIPC’s construct validity and reliability.

arxiv-2105-10920.description: Abstract . Recently, DETR and Deformable DETR have been proposed to eliminate the need for many hand-designed components in object detection while demonstrating good performance as previous complex hand-crafted detectors. However, their performance on Video Object Detection (VOD) has not been well explored.

arxiv-2204-13127.title: Polarization power spectra and dust cloud morphology
arxiv-2204-13127.creator: A. Konstantinou ,, V. Pelgrims ,, F. Fuchs, K. Tassis
arxiv-2204-13127.description: Abstract Context. In the framework of cosmic microwave background polarization studies and the characterization of its Galactic foregrounds, the angular power spectrum analysis of the thermal dust polarization map has led to intriguing evidence of an E / B E/B asymmetry and a positive T ​ E TE correlation.

arxiv-2211-05092.title: Clinical Contrastive Learning for Biomarker Detection
arxiv-2211-05092.creator: Kiran Kokilepersaud, Mohit Prabhushankar, Ghassan AlRegib
arxiv-2211-05092.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel positive and negative set selection strategy for contrastive learning of medical images based on labels that can be extracted from clinical data . In the medical field, there exists a variety of labels for data that serve different purposes at different stages of a diagnostic and treatment process.

arxiv-2301-00390.title: Impact of CP violation searches at MOMENT experiment with sterile neutrinos
arxiv-2301-00390.creator: Kiran Sharma, Sudhanwa Patra
arxiv-2301-00390.description: Abstract We examine the scope of the MOMENT experiment in the context of CP violation searches with the presence of extra eV scale sterile neutrino. MOMENT is a proposed short baseline neutrino oscillation experiment using muon beams for neutrinos production, making it advantageous over π 0 \pi_{0} background and other technical difficulties.

arxiv-2406-01344.title: Unusual low-temperature behavior in the half-filled band of the one-dimensional extended Hubbard model in atomic limit
arxiv-2406-01344.creator: Onofre Rojas, S. M. de Souza, J. Torrico, L. M. Verissimo, M. S. S. Pereira, M. L. Lyra, Oleg Derzhko
arxiv-2406-01344.description: Abstract Recently, a kind of finite-temperature pseudo-transition was observed in several quasi-one-dimensional models. In this work, we consider a genuine one-dimensional extended Hubbard model in the atomic limit, influenced by an external magnetic field and with the arbitrary number of particles controlled by the chemical potential.

arxiv-2406-15183.title: Subresiduated Nelson Algebras
arxiv-2406-15183.creator: Noemí Lubomirsky, Paula Menchón, Hernán San Martín
arxiv-2406-15183.description: Abstract In this paper we generalize the well known relation between Heyting algebras and Nelson algebras in the framework of subresiduated lattices. In order to make it possible, we introduce the variety of subresiduated Nelson algebras. The main tool for its study is the construction provided by Vakarelov.

arxiv-2504-19500.title: Masked Point-Entity Contrast for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding
arxiv-2504-19500.creator: Yan Wang, Baoxiong Jia, Ziyu Zhu, Siyuan Huang
arxiv-2504-19500.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yan Wang, Baoxiong Jia, Ziyu Zhu, Siyuan Huang. Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding is pivotal for enhancing physical intelligence, as it enables embodied agents to interpret and interact dynamically within real-world environments. This paper introduces MPEC , a novel M asked P oint- E ntity C ontrastive learning method for open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation that leverages both 3D entity-language alignment and point-entity consistency across different point cloud views to foster entity-specific feature representations.

arxiv-2507-20288.title: A nonparametric approach to practical identifiability of nonlinear mixed effects models
arxiv-2507-20288.creator: Tyler Cassidy, Stuart T. Johnston, Michael Plank, Imke Botha, Jennifer A. Flegg, Ryan J. Murphy, Sara Hamis

pmc-10671866.title: Foraging Behaviors of Red Imported Fire Ants (Hymenoptera Formicidae) in Response to Bait Containing Different Concentrations of Fipronil, Abamectin, or Indoxacarb
pmc-10671866.creator: Chengju Du, Hailong Lyu, Lanfeng Wang, Lei Mao, Lin Li, Xinya Yang, Cai Wang
pmc-10671866.description: Simple SummaryBoth field and laboratory studies showed that 0.0125% fipronil bait is repellent against S. invicta workers; therefore, higher concentrations of fipronil should be avoided in fire ant bait production. In future studies evaluating the effectiveness of fire ant baits, we suggest considering the effect of active ingredients and their concentrations on bait acceptance.

pmc-11435784.title: DSC-Net: Enhancing Blind Road Semantic Segmentation with Visual Sensor Using a Dual-Branch Swin-CNN Architecture
pmc-11435784.creator: Ying Yuan, Yu Du, Yan Ma, Hejun Lv, Stefanos Vrochidis
pmc-11435784.description: In modern urban environments, visual sensors are crucial for enhancing the functionality of navigation systems, particularly for devices designed for visually impaired individuals. The high-resolution images captured by these sensors form the basis for understanding the surrounding environment and identifying key landmarks.

pmc-11464508.title: PRN: progressive reasoning network and its image completion applications
pmc-11464508.creator: Yongqin Zhang, Xiaoyu Wang, Panpan Zhu, Xuan Lu, Jinsheng Xiao, Wei Zhou, Zhan Li, Xianlin Peng
pmc-11464508.description: Ancient murals embody profound historical, cultural, scientific, and artistic values, yet many are afflicted with challenges such as pigment shedding or missing parts. While deep learning-based completion techniques have yielded remarkable results in restoring natural images, their application to damaged murals has been unsatisfactory due to data shifts and limited modeling efficacy.

pmc-11672141.title: Machine-Learning-Aided Engineering Hemoglobin as Carbene Transferase for Catalyzing Enantioselective Olefin Cyclopropanation
pmc-11672141.creator: Hanqing Xie, Kaifeng Liu, Zhengqiang Li, Zhi Wang, Chunyu Wang, Fengxi Li, Weiwei Han, Lei Wang
pmc-11672141.description: In this study, we developed a machine-learning-aided protein design strategy for engineering Vitreoscilla hemoglobin (VHb) as carbene transferase. A Natural Language Processing (NLP) model was used for the first time to construct an algorithm (EESP, enzyme enantioselectivity score predictor) and predict the enantioselectivity of VHb.

pmc-12456753.title: Lidocaine-Based vs Sufentanil-Based PCIA After Pulmonary Resection Surgery: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-12456753.creator: Bin Tian, Yumin Wu, Wenjie Zhang, Ruijuan Liu, Song Qu, Zhenying Zhang, Wenjun Yan
pmc-12456753.description: BackgroundWe investigated the efficacy and safety of lidocaine-based patient-controlled intravenous analgesia (PCIA), compared with sufentanil-based PCIA on postoperative pain and recovery quality in patients undergoing thoracoscopic lung surgery.MethodsWe recruited 160 patients undergoing thoracoscopic lung surgery who were randomized to receive lidocaine-based PCIA (1.5 mg/kg/h) or sufentanil-based PCIA (2 μg/mL) within 48 hours postoperatively.

pmc-12506416.title: Hepatic function is associated with cognitive function in patients with stable schizophrenia
pmc-12506416.creator: Jian Han, Xiu Li, Yanping Feng, Yan Guo, Binyou Wang, Yilin Wang
pmc-12506416.description: BackgroundThe liver-brain axis, mediated by inflammatory cytokines, metabolic byproducts, and oxidative stress, shares pathological pathways with schizophrenia neurobiology. Despite this overlap, direct clinical evidence linking hepatic function indicators to psychiatric symptoms or cognitive function in schizophrenia remains limited. Therefore, this study investigated associations between clinical hepatic function indicators and both psychiatric symptoms and cognitive performance in individuals with stable schizophrenia.

pmc-12608693.title: Ubiquitin E3 Ligases and p53 in Doxorubicin-Induced Cardiotoxicity
pmc-12608693.creator: Shingo Tachibana, Yoichiro Otaki, Jun Goto, Tetsu Watanabe, Masafumi Watanabe, Michele Samaja
pmc-12608693.description: Doxorubicin (Dox) is a widely used anti-cancer drug. It has proven efficacy against various cancers, although the clinical application of Dox has been limited due to dose-dependent, irreversible, and fatal Dox-induced cardiotoxicity (DIC). The mechanism of DIC remains unclear. p53 plays a key role in DIC via cardiomyocyte loss due to cell death and oxidative stress.

pmc-12617767.title: The clinical characteristics and treatment response of myasthenia gravis with positive thyroid peroxidase antibody or thyroid globulin antibody
pmc-12617767.creator: Hanyu Xin, Mingou Lu
pmc-12617767.description: Background and purposeMyasthenia gravis (MG) frequently associates with thyroid peroxidase antibody (TPOAb) and thyroglobulin antibody (TgAb), indicating shared autoimmunity. This study investigated the impact of TPOAb/TgAb on MG severity and pathogenesis, to inform improved management.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed 144 MG patients (Jan 2022–Dec 2024), stratified into four groups by TPOAb/TgAb status.

pmc-12766391.title: Palliative resection versus palliative stenting for intestinal obstruction in patients with metastatic left-sided colonic cancer: a propensity score–matched analysis
pmc-12766391.creator: Ruby Siu Ting Lau, Sophie Sok Fei Hon, Man Fung Ho, Simon Chu, Dennis CK Ng, Simon SM Ng
pmc-12766391.description: PurposePalliative resection and palliative stenting are established options for managing obstruction in patients with metastatic left-sided colonic cancer. This retrospective study investigated the long-term outcomes and survival associated with each treatment modality.MethodsPatients with left-sided colon cancer complicated by intestinal obstruction and unresectable metastatic lesions were included. Propensity score matching was conducted to balance demographic characteristics.

pmc-13381924.title: Research on the residual mechanical properties of hybrid fiber ECCs after high-temperature exposure
pmc-13381924.creator: Jinyu Cui, Hao Jiang, Yunlong Zhang, Ao Zhang
pmc-13381924.description: In this work, the mechanical properties of hybrid fiber-reinforced cementitious composites (CP-ECCs) composed of polypropylene fibers (PPs) with varying volume fractions and 1% volume fraction chopped carbon fibers (CFs), as well as the influence of different fly ash (FA) contents on material performance under both room temperature (20 °C) and high-temperature conditions, are systematically studied.

pmc-13548262.title: Effects of electronic patient-reported outcome monitoring on symptom burden and health-related quality of life in patients with metastatic breast cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis protocol
pmc-13548262.creator: Huanhuan Xiong, Qijing Luan, Wei Li, Pingping Tian, Jie Ning, Zhihao Han
pmc-13548262.description: AbstractIntroductionMetastatic breast cancer is increasingly managed as a long-term condition, yet symptom burden and health-related quality of life (HRQoL) remain major patient-centred concerns. Electronic patient-reported outcome (ePRO) monitoring has shown promise in improving symptom surveillance and supporting more responsive care in oncology; however, evidence specifically relating to metastatic breast cancer remains fragmented and has not yet been systematically synthesised.

pmc-13610792.title: Association Between Inclusive Educational Environments and Food Allergy Comprehension Among Preschool Children: A Quasi-Experimental Digital Intervention Study
pmc-13610792.creator: Tomoko Noma, Kyosuke Nowaki, Mei Nunoya, Haruna Koyama, Ayano Nishizoe
pmc-13610792.description: Background/Objectives: This study examined whether sharing a class with a peer with physician-diagnosed food allergy (FA) was associated with post-intervention FA comprehension among preschool children. Methods: A four-month ARCS motivation model-based digital nutrition education program was delivered to 163 five-year-old preschoolers from nine public kindergartens. The program provided instruction on knowledge of balanced diets and FA.
